title: Figures 22-23: HPFL MOPA design and fiber laser beam combining techniques
description: Figure 22, "Typical HPFL MOPA Design," shows a master oscillator feeding a (6+1) to 1 combiner with fiber-coupled pump modules, doped double-clad gain fiber and a high-power endcap. Figure 23, "Fiber Laser Beam Combining Techniques," is a slide titled "State of the Art in Fiber Combining" with six panels: passive phasing, coherent beam combining (CBC), incoherent beam combining with a hexagonal beam director, Talbot self-imaging coupling, spectral beam combining with a grating, and MOPA with active phase control. Both are credited to the Directed Energy Professional Society.
